description: Source code for RPM archive handling, including functions for extracting RPM files, converting RPM to cpio format, listing archive contents, and extracting files, with external dependencies on RPM, cpio, and system utilities.

methods.name: xa_rpm_ask
methods.description: Sets capabilities of the archive object, allowing extraction, full path access, touching, and overwriting.

methods.name: xa_rpm2cpio
methods.description: Converts an RPM archive to a cpio archive by reading RPM signature and header sections, extracting payload, and decompressing based on archive type.

methods.name: xa_rpm_list
methods.description: Lists contents of RPM archive by converting to cpio and parsing output.

methods.name: xa_rpm_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified files from RPM archive by converting to cpio and performing extraction.
